headline_of_the_week: Innovate UK backs 61 women founders with 75K GBP each while Genius AI twin sisters hit unicorn at 1.15B USD, Volta AI raises 300M at 2.4B with a female co-founder, Citation Capital closes a 1.2B female-led PE debut, and Cut Through Q2 shows 95 percent of Australian early-stage still male-only.

headlines.title: Innovate UK Women in Innovation Awards 2026: 61 women funded at 75K GBP each
headlines.summary: 1,590 women applied to Innovate UK Women in Innovation. 61 were funded at 75K GBP each with 12 months of business support. Verinity's Melody Williams is a named winner.

headlines.title: Genius AI (fka GlossGenius) hits unicorn at 1.15B USD led by twin sisters Cohen-Shohet
headlines.summary: Danielle and Leah Cohen-Shohet closed a 44M USD Series D for Genius AI at a 1.15B valuation. Year's first female co-founder unicorn from a sibling duo in beauty and services AI.

headlines.title: Volta AI emerges from stealth with 300M USD at 2.4B valuation, co-founded by Sofia Gumuzio
headlines.summary: London-based Volta AI raised roughly 300M USD across seed and Series A at a 2.4B valuation from a16z, Altimeter, NVIDIA and Azora. Co-founder Sofia Gumuzio is a rare female founder in frontier AI infrastructure.

headlines.title: Citation Capital closes 1.2B USD inaugural fund led by Hagge and Hudson
headlines.summary: Tiffany K. Hagge and Lydie B. Hudson closed Citation Capital's first fund at 1.2B USD. A rare institutional PE debut led entirely by female GPs and backed at scale by institutional LPs.

headlines.title: Cut Through Q2 2026: 95 percent of Australian Angel and Pre-Seed rounds went to male-only teams
headlines.summary: Cut Through's Q2 2026 tracker logs A$1.7B across 64 Australian rounds. Angel and Pre-Seed remained 95 percent male-only, concentrating the reset at the earliest rung of the ladder.

headlines.title: WINS List 20: 9B USD raised by women-led venture funds and 806M USD into women's health in 60 days
headlines.summary: Amie Sheridan's WINS List 20 documents 9B USD raised by women-led venture funds and 806M USD deployed into women's health startups over the last 60 days.

headlines.title: Expedition Therapeutics secures 125M USD Series A led by Bain Capital Life Sciences
headlines.summary: Yi Larson-led Expedition Therapeutics raised 125M USD Series A led by Bain Capital Life Sciences, extending capital access for women-led biotech.

headlines.title: Aavalynx closes 1.75M USD pre-seed for AI-native agentic commerce
headlines.summary: Aavalynx raised a 1.75M USD pre-seed for AI-native agentic commerce infrastructure. Founded by a female operator with prior enterprise fintech background.

headlines.title: Verinity's Melody Williams wins Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award
headlines.summary: Melody Williams, Verinity's founder, is named a 2026 Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award winner. Verinity's APP fraud prevention platform continues expanding to UK banks.

headlines.title: Israel Innovation Authority Startup Fund open call continues
headlines.summary: IIA Startup Fund remains open for early-stage Israeli companies, providing non-dilutive R&D grants. Rolling window active through the summer.

headlines.title: EU Startup and Scaleup Strategy progress note flags execution gaps
headlines.summary: European Commission Progress-so-far note on the EU Startup and Scaleup Strategy flags implementation gaps around female founder capital access at Series B and above.

headlines.title: Entreprenista August 2026 grants roundup for women founders
headlines.summary: Entreprenista publishes its August 2026 grants roundup, listing active US and international non-dilutive funding open to women founders this month.
